triggers.detailsText: The Company commenced the Buyback on September 22, 2026 (“ Commencement Date”) from its shareholders (other than those who are promoters, members of the promoter group, persons in control (and their associates)), from the open market through stock exchange mechanism, in accordance with the Buyback Regulations and Companies Act. In this regard, please be informed that, as on October 9, 2026 (being the last of Buyback Period), the Company has bought back 73,00,000 Equity Shares at an average price of ₹ 385.26 (Rupees Three Hundred and Eighty Five and Twenty Six Paise Only) per Equity Share. Accordingly, the Company has deployed ₹ 2,81,24,10,607.90 (Rupees Two Hundred and Eighty One Crore Twenty Four Lakhs Ten Thousand Six Hundred Seven and Ninety Paise only) which represents 99.73% of the Maximum Buyback Size.
